answer_3.quote: To understand how well different large language models can grade complex judicial reasoning chains, we instantiate four state-of-the-art models as evaluators: OpenAI o3 (OpenAI, 2025a), Claude-3.7 (Anthropic, 2025), Gemini-Pro (Google DeepMind, 2025), Gemini-Flash (DeepMind, 2025) and Qwen2.5-72B .

answer_4.quote: Evaluation is conducted by experienced U.S. lawyers and paralegals, who assess outputs on three dimensions: 1) citation relevance, i.e., is precedent correctly cited and applied? 2) constraint extraction, i.e., are the conditions of the cited rule correctly identified? 3) argument validity, i.e., do the conclusions logically follow from the cited law and facts?
answer_4.guideline: assess outputs on citation relevance, constraint extraction, and argument validity
